plan: Normalize and validate requirements into deterministic ID order.
Evaluate every blocking rule, including overnight weekday attribution and half-open time intervals.
Apply emergency overrides to collected failures, then sort explanations by requirement ID.
Implement batch, dry-run replacement, and emergency-impact helpers without mutating inputs.
